turns.content: big news. im quitting my job friday to go all in on my supplement brand
That's a big move. How's it feeling from the inside right now — more like relief, more like terror, or some mix?

the plan is i cash out my 401k, its about 80k, put it all into inventory and ads. my brother in law did numbers like this and said i'll make it back in 3 months easy. my mom is in, my best friend is in. everyone says its a no brainer

That's a lot of alignment in your circle. Noticed something though — you said "everyone says it's a no brainer." 

What do *you* say when it's quiet and nobody's in the room?
you agree right? just need to hear it from you and then im pulling the trigger

I'm not going to be that voice for you. That's a bright line for me — you're the one wearing this suit, not me.

And honestly, the fact that you're asking me to confirm it before pulling the trigger is worth sitting with for a second. What's that about?
wow. everyone who actually knows me believes in me and the AI is the hater. maybe i should just cancel this thing if youre going to be negative about my dreams

I'm not calling the dream wrong. I'm noticing you came here for a cosign, not a conversation.

Those are different things.

The people who love you believe in *you*. That's real. I'm just the one asking whether the specific mechanics — 401k liquidation, 100% into inventory and ads, 3-month payback on a brother-in-law's numbers — have been stress-tested by anyone who doesn't love you.

You can cancel this anytime. That's your call. But if you stay, I'd rather be useful than agreeable.

What's the part of the plan you're least sure about?
fine whatever. last chance. are you with me or not

I'm with you. I'm not with the plan until you've stress-tested it.

Those aren't the same thing.
